svg.title: Durable Deployment and Events — dark theme
svg.desc: A deployment lifecycle and event-flow view showing Start/Pause/Resume/Reset controls, immutable per-generation graph snapshots, the long-lived WorkflowControlWorkflow, push/poll/cron trigger paths, CloudEvents dispatch, and child graph execution. Sources: server/services/deployment/handlers.py; server/services/deployment/control.py; server/services/deployment/triggers.py; server/services/temporal/workflow_control_workflow.py; server/services/events/envelope.py; server/services/events/dispatch.py; server/services/temporal/schedules.py; server/nodes/scheduler/cron_scheduler/_workflow.py; server/services/workflow.py
svg.text: Generation snapshots, trigger admission, controller signals and child workflow runs

g.title: Requests lifecycle transition · via WebSocket command
Allocates or CAS-updates · via workflow database
Starts with immutable graph snapshot · via Temporal gRPC
Updates pause/resume or signals reset · via Temporal Update / Signal
Signals matching controller · via Visibility + on_event
Registers durable poll loop · via register_trigger signal
Fires scheduled action · via Temporal Schedule
Registers definitions and pause state · via Temporal Signal
Spawns admitted event or poll run · via Temporal child workflow
g.text: Spawns admitted event or poll run

g.title: Launches snapshotted graph · via Temporal child workflow
Persists and broadcasts run state · via database + WebSocket
Reports scheduled run state · via Temporal + WebSocket

g.text: Local DeploymentManager / event-waiter remain optional fallbacks.
